# Faux Spy

> Faux Spy is a free browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge that tells you whether a photo or video is AI-generated. Right-click any image — on Tinder, Bumble, Instagram, Facebook or any other site — and get a verdict with a confidence score in about two seconds. It is built to help people spot fake dating profiles, catfish and romance scammers who use AI-generated photos.

Key facts:
- Free plan: 3 scans per day, no account or credit card needed.
- Paid plans: Secret Agent $9.99/month or Master Spy $99/year (200 scans/month each); Pro + Video $29.99/month adds AI video detection. All paid plans have a 14-day money-back guarantee.
- Detection: images are analyzed by Hive and Sightengine detection models, plus a C2PA content-credential and EXIF metadata check. Results are a confidence percentage, not a flat yes/no.
- Detects output from Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, Leonardo AI and other major generators. Video detection targets Sora, Runway, Pika, Veo and Kling.
- Privacy: only the URL of the image the user chooses to scan is sent for analysis. No browsing history or personal information is collected.
- Limitations: no detector is 100% accurate. Compressed thumbnails and newer generators are harder to classify. AI detection does not catch stolen real photos; pair it with a reverse image search for that.
